transc:

do not regard the line of
the Goose Valley as important for
ulterior objects it is important only
so long as the wiley remains
near Optic & we cannot follow
that line far beyond that point
simply because the Country is destitute
of supplies & we have not
sufficient means of stomach to enable
us to Wallace more than twenty
or twenty five miles beyond a

upon Staunton it will be impossible
